body:
related #2097

**tendon cell**

- reclassify to 'fibroblast' and 'part of' some 'tendon' 
- adjust the textual def accordingly

**otic fibrocyte**
- reclassify from fibrocyte to mesenchymal cell (PMID: [37720106](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37720106/))
- add synonyms - cochlear fibrocyte (PMID: [31866825](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/31866825/)) and spiral ligament fibrocyte (PMID: [33193034](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/33193034/)

**In a seperate ticket - refine otic fibrobalst and subclasses**
1) Currently, otic fibroblast is linked to spiral ligmanet but it encompasses both spiral ligament and spiral limbus - This definition should be relabelled to Cochlear fibrocytes (more widely used) and treated as the general term 
2) A spiral ligament fibrocyte term should be added and all Type I-V subclasses should be added under it 
3) More info should be added to the textual defs of the subclasses (especially functions) 

Useful refs 

- PMID: 24727668
- PMID: [31866825](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/31866825/)
- PMID: [37720106](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37720106/) - newer paper
- PMID: [33193034](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/33193034/) - newer paper -specific to Spiral ligament fibrocytes
title: remove tendon cell and otic fibrocyte from under fibrocyte
